Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TYPE_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع المعاملة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TIR_HEAD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TIR_HQ_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TERMN_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المستخدم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'DCLTN_STA_CD,DCLTN_TYPE_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جهة الأوضاع الخاصه', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_MNFCT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,MNFCT_NBR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INSPECTOR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم المعاين - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IMP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,IMPR_NBR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_GROUP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رقم مجموعة المعاينة,رمز الميناء' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_FRIMEX_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FRGN_IMP_EXP_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_EXIT_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز منفذ الخروج', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_DHLOWN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في مالك بوليصة البريد السريع الدولي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في دولة الوصول النهائي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BRKRAUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'BRKR_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BKM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم الرخصة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AG_AUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'AGNT_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AGNT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الشركة الوسيطة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AEO_REAS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات سبب اختيار المشغل الأقتصادى - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'ID_TRANSIT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TRNST_NBR,TRNST_DT,TRNST_TYPE,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);

 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الجمرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'ID_IG_REASSIGNED_TO_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,RE_INSPTR_ID,RE_GRP_ID' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'ID_IG_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رقم المعاين' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'ID_DCLTN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمز الجمرك,الرقم المبدئي للبيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'معاينين البيان','البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'Insptr Dcltns','البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SD_USR_TERMN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المستخدم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_TRT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TRANSPORTER_CODE' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_TOT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TRNST_OWNER_TYPE' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_TIR_HEAD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TIR_HQ_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_TBA_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,TRNST_BRK_AUTHR_ISN' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_SPCL_DEPT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'SPCL_DEPT_ID' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_SDP_OTHER_FK') THEN

------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD LIKE FN THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE = 6
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);

 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_REP_FRM_FLG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,

 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN

 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('مسار ملف التقرير غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('ملف التقرير غير معرف داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTNT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'ID_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الجمرك,مسلسل' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SD_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ - تكرار في رقم البيان الإحصائي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VALID_DATE_NUMBER') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في عملية ترقيم البيان الجمركي - يجب وجود رقم وتاريخ في نفس الوقت', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CHK_DEC_LINK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(14, 'Invalid combination of <p1>', 'الرقم المبدئي للبيان,Stats Isn' ), 'E', 'OFG', 14);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES */
PROCEDURE CGLY$DISPLAY_CANVASES(
 P_CANVAS_LIST IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* List of displayed canvases */
 ,P_CURRENT_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2 /* Current canvas */
 ,P_BASE_CANVAS IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Base canvas */
/* Display the current canvas plus any others in the canvas list */
 canvas_list VARCHAR2(255); /* List of displayed canvases */
 canvas_to_raise VARCHAR2(255); /* Canvas to raise to the top */
BEGIN
 IF ( P_CURRENT_CANVAS = P_BASE_CANVAS) THEN
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 ELSE
 P_CANVAS_LIST := replace(P_CANVAS_LIST, P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',');
 IF ( get_view_property(P_BASE_CANVAS, VISIBLE) = 'FALSE') THEN
 canvas_list := P_CANVAS_LIST;
 WHILE (canvas_list IS NOT NULL) LOOP
 canvas_to_raise := substr(canvas_list, 1, instr(canvas_list, ','));
 canvas_list := replace(canvas_list, canvas_to_raise);
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(rtrim(canvas_to_raise, ','));
 END LOOP;
 END IF;
 P_CANVAS_LIST := P_CANVAS_LIST || P_CURRENT_CANVAS || ',';
 END IF;
 CGLY$RAISE_CANVAS(P_CURRENT_CANVAS);
END;

/* Top level canvas management procedure */
 current_canvas VARCHAR2(61) := get_item_property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ITEM_CANVAS);

FUNCTION CHK_GRP(P_PORT_CD NUMBER,P_GRP_CD NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS

 FROM DCLTN_GRP_SHIFTS
 WHERE PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND GRP_ID = P_GRP_CD

 ORDER BY TO_CHAR(SFT_STIME,'HH24:MI') DESC;

 V_ST DATE;

 V_TST NUMBER := 0 ;
 V_CNT1 NUMBER;
 V_CNT2 NUMBER;
 G_DATE DATE;

 BEGIN
 G_DATE := SYSDATE;

----------- التأكد من عدم تداخل الفترات بنفس الوقت
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT1
 FROM DCLTN_GRP_SHIFTS DGS_PARNT
 WHERE DGS_PARNT.STATUS = 1
 AND DGS_PARNT.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND DGS_PARNT.GRP_ID = P_GRP_CD
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
 FROM DCLTN_GRP_SHIFTS DGS_CHLD
 WHERE( (TO_CHAR(DGS_CHLD.SFT_STIME,'HH24:MI') >= TO_CHAR(DGS_PARNT.SFT_STIME,'HH24:MI'))
 AND(TO_CHAR(DGS_CHLD.SFT_STIME,'HH24:MI') <= TO_CHAR(DGS_PARNT.SFT_ETIME,'HH24:MI'))
 AND(DGS_CHLD.ROWID != DGS_PARNT.ROWID )
 AND DGS_CHLD.STATUS = 1
 AND DGS_CHLD.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND DGS_CHLD.GRP_ID = P_GRP_CD
 )
 );

 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT2
 FROM DCLTN_GRP_SHIFTS DGS_PARNT
 WHERE DGS_PARNT.STATUS = 1
 AND DGS_PARNT.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND DGS_PARNT.GRP_ID = P_GRP_CD
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
 FROM DCLTN_GRP_SHIFTS DGS_CHLD
 WHERE( (TO_CHAR(DGS_CHLD.SFT_ETIME,'HH24:MI') >= TO_CHAR(DGS_PARNT.SFT_STIME,'HH24:MI'))
 AND(TO_CHAR(DGS_CHLD.SFT_ETIME,'HH24:MI') <= TO_CHAR(DGS_PARNT.SFT_ETIME,'HH24:MI'))
 AND( DGS_CHLD.ROWID != DGS_PARNT.ROWID )
 AND STATUS = 1
 AND DGS_CHLD.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND DGS_CHLD.GRP_ID = P_GRP_CD
 )
 );

 IF V_CNT1 != 0 OR V_CNT2 != 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يوجد خطأ في إعداد الفترات .. لا يمكن تحضير المعاينين','ERROR');
-- RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 RETURN 0;

 END IF;
--------------------------------------------------------
 OPEN C1;
 LOOP
 FETCH C1 INTO V_SI,V_ST,V_ET;
 --الفترة بنفس اليوم --
 IF V_ET > V_ST THEN
 IF TO_CHAR(G_DATE,'HH24:MI') BETWEEN TO_CHAR(V_ST,'HH24:MI') AND TO_CHAR(V_ET,'HH24:MI') THEN
 V_TST := 1;
 END IF;
 ELSE -- الفترة بيومين
 -- الفترة بيومين و الوقت الأن في اليوم الأول --
 IF TO_CHAR(G_DATE,'HH24:MI') > TO_CHAR(V_ST,'HH24:MI') THEN
 V_TST := 1;
 ELSE --الفترة بيومين والوقت الأن في اليوم الثاني --
 --الوقت قبل انتهاء الفترة
 IF TO_CHAR(G_DATE,'HH24:MI') < TO_CHAR(V_ET,'HH24:MI') THEN
 /*NIHAD KHALIL STOP CODE FOR WORK 3THSHIFT */ --V_TST := 2;
 V_TST := 1;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 EXIT WHEN V_TST IN (1,2) OR C1%NOTFOUND;
 END LOOP;
 IF V_TST = 2 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('يجب تحضير المعاينين في اليوم الأول من الفترة .. لا يمكن تحضير المعاينين','ERROR');
 -- RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 RETURN 0;

 END IF;
 IF C1%ROWCOUNT = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لم يتم تسجيل وردية لهذه المجموعة .. لا يمكن تحضير المعاينين','ERROR');
-- RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 CLOSE C1;
 RETURN 1;
 END;

 SELECT * FROM
 (
 SELECT ID.*,1 DCLN_TYPE,WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL WRK_ASN_LVL
 FROM DECLARATIONS D, INSPTR_DCLTNS ID
 WHERE D.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND D.GROUP_ID = V_GRP_ID
 AND D.INSPTR_ID IS NULL
 AND ID.PORT_CD = D.PORT_CD
 AND ID.DCLTN_ISN = D.DCLTN_ISN
 AND ID.ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 AND (LIB_USR.DCLTN_UTILITIES.ALLW_ASSGIN_INSPCT(D.PORT_CD,D.DCLTN_ISN,D.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1) -- wakeel cr_6601_2 cr_6601_3
 AND id.rmv_dt IS NULL -- wakeel cr_6601_2 cr_6601_3
 UNION
 SELECT ID.*,2 DCLN_TYPE,WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL WRK_ASN_LVL
 FROM STATS_DCLTNS SD, INSPTR_DCLTNS ID
 WHERE SD.PORT_CD = V_PORT_CD
 AND SD.GRP_ID = V_GRP_ID
 AND SD.INSPTR_NBR IS NULL
 AND ID.PORT_CD = SD.PORT_CD
 AND ID.STATS_ISN = SD.STATS_ISN
 AND ID.ASSGIN_DT IS NULL
 )
 ORDER BY WRK_ASN_LVL DESC,DCLN_TYPE

 ;

 V_INSPTR VARCHAR2(200);
 H_DATE DATE;
 G_DATE DATE:=SYSDATE;
BEGIN
 H_DATE := HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE;

 FOR I IN C_INSPTR_DCLTNS(P_PORT_CD, P_GRP_ID) LOOP
 V_INSPTR := GET_MIN_JOB_INSPTR(P_PORT_CD, P_GRP_ID, P_SHIFT_ID);

 IF V_INSPTR IS NOT NULL THEN

 UPDATE INSPTR_DCLTNS
 SET GRP_ID= P_GRP_ID,
 INSPTR_ID = V_INSPTR,
 ASSGIN_DT = H_DATE,
 ASS_GREG_DT = G_DATE
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND ASSIGN_ISN = I.ASSIGN_ISN
 ;
 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 15, 7, I.PORT_CD||'!'||I.ASSIGN_ISN) THEN
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK(NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 -- WAKEEL CR_5595

 V_CNT NUMBER ;

 IF NVL (gnrl.get_customs_setting ('CHANGE_DEC_COC_PATH',21),0) = 1 THEN

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM XRAY_SUSPCT_PRE_GATE XPR ,DECLARATIONS DC

 AND DC.DCLTN_STA_CD = 5
 AND XPR.DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN ;

 IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
 UPDATE XRAY_SUSPCT_PRE_GATE
 SET SUSPCT_STAGE_CD = 2
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD AND DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 216,I.PORT_CD||'!'||I.DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END;
 -- WAKEEL CR_5595

 IF I.DCLN_TYPE = 1 THEN
 UPDATE DECLARATIONS
 SET INSPTR_ID = V_INSPTR
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = I.DCLTN_ISN;

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(21, 1, 104, I.PORT_CD||'!'||I.DCLTN_ISN) THEN
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK(NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 ELSIF I.DCLN_TYPE = 2 THEN
 UPDATE STATS_DCLTNS
 SET INSPTR_NBR = V_INSPTR
 WHERE PORT_CD = I.PORT_CD
 AND STATS_ISN = I.STATS_ISN;

 IF NOT ACTIVITY.ADD_ACTIVITY(27, 1, 62, I.PORT_CD||'!'||I.STATS_ISN) THEN
 ISSUE_ROLLBACK(NULL);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 END IF;

 UPDATE INSPTR_GRPS
 SET ACT_DCLTN_COUNT = ACT_DCLTN_COUNT + 1,
 WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL= WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL + I.WORK_ASSIGN_LEVEL
 WHERE PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND GRP_ID = P_GRP_ID
 AND USER_ID = V_INSPTR
 ;


 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن الحصول علي معاينين حاضرين في المجموعة - تأكد من خطة الحضور للمجموعة' ,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;


 END LOOP;
 FORMS_DDL('COMMIT');
 STR.DISPALERT('تمت عملية التوزيع بنجاح' ,'INFORMATION');
END;

 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := FALSE;
 END IF;
END;
/* CGLY$MANAGE_CANVASES */
/* Call procedure to ensure correct canvases are visible */
BEGIN
 CGLY$CANVAS_MANAGEMENT;
END;


/* CGLT$TAB_NEW_BLOCK */
/* Show canvases for this block */
BEGIN
 IF CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE = TRUE THEN
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.CGLT$NEW_BLOCK;
 END IF;
END;

/* CGBS$WHEN_NEW_BLOCK_INSTANCE */
/* ensure the current canvas is correctly coordinated */
BEGIN
 CGBS$.NEW_BLOCK( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE);
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-CLEAR-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$ON_CLEAR_DETAILS */
/* clear all detail blocks for the given master block */
BEGIN
 IF (FORM_FAILURE AND :SYSTEM.COORDINATION_OPERATION IN ('MOUSE', 'DUPLICATE_RECORD')) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF (:SYSTEM.MASTER_BLOCK = :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK) THEN
 CGBS$.CLEAR_MASTER_DETAIL( :SYSTEM.MASTER_BLOCK, :SYSTEM.COORDINATION_OPERATION );
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$ON_POPULATE_DETAILS */
/* query all detail blocks for the given master block */
BEGIN
 CGBS$.QUERY_DETAILS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CQUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$KEY_CQUERY_FRM */
/* Check if query is allowed to avoid unnecessary coordination */
BEGIN
 IF (get_block_property( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK, QUERY_ALLOWED) = 'FALSE') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(37, 'Query not allowed in this block'), 'E', 'OFG', 37);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 CGBS$.DO_KEYQRY( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK, 'COUNT_QUERY', :SYSTEM.MODE);
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$KEY_CLRREC */
/* Avoid clearing details if current row is new and invalid */
BEGIN
 IF ( CGBS2$.IS_RECORD_DIRTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK) ) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF (:SYSTEM.BLOCK_STATUS = 'CHANGED' OR CGBS2$.IS_COMMIT_NEEDED( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK ) ) THEN
 CGBS2$.DO_COMMIT_DIALOGUE;
 END IF;
 clear_record;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NXTKEY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$DISABLE_NXTKEY */
/* Disable KEY-NXTKEY for the whole form */
BEGIN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(30, 'Key not valid in this context'), 'E', 'OFG', 30);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-MENU
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE_QUERY_MODE */
/* This changes the mode of block synchronization so that if it is */
/* currently ON, then it is changed to OFF, and vice-versa. */
/* It also queries the dependent blocks as appropriate for the */
/* new mode. */
BEGIN
 CGBS$TOGGLE( :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CLRFRM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGGN$KEY_CLRFRM */
/* Perform the key's standard functionality */
BEGIN
 clear_form;
 IF :SYSTEM.FORM_STATUS = 'CHANGED' THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

/* CGCF$PERFORM_STARTUP */
/* execute the when-new-form-instance code that was created by forms generator */
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-TAB-PAGE-CHANGED
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGLT$NEW_TAB_PAGE */
/* Show related canvases for this tab */
BEGIN
 IF( :SYSTEM.TAB_NEW_PAGE IN ( 'CG$M_TAB_1_PAGE_1', 'CG$M_TAB_1_PAGE_2' ) ) THEN
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.ACTIVATE := TRUE;
 CGLT$TAB_BLOCKS.CGLT$TAB_CHANGED;
 END IF;
END;
